## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +1.79% | 1M: -13.87%) RECOVERY ↑ rising and credit stress rising — credit spread (HYG/LQD proxy) 0.7338 (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.54%) ABOVE TREND — offset by SPY/TLT (Stocks vs Bonds) 8.1854 (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +7.79%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +14.46%) ABOVE TREND, so signals are mixed.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: Credit spread 0.7338 (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.54%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Fear edging up: VXX (1W: +1.79% | 1M: -13.87%) RECOVERY ↑ rising. Reflation/commodity push: CPER (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising vs GLD (1W: -2.05% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION ↓ falling.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-tight: UUP (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -0.43%) RECOVERY and Yield Curve 1.0493 (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.33%) BELOW TREND → flat, implying modestly tighter conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leading but breadth mixed: XLK (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +14.46%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +8.63% | 1M: +29.32%) ABOVE TREND showing strength, while Financials (XLF) are in CORRECTION (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +6.87%); Style: Growth showing leadership but breadth is only 5/11 so leadership is not broad.

5. US vs Global?  
US outperforming: SPY (1W: +0.97% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND; ex-US patchy with EM/China in CORRECTION — EEM (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +10.31%) CORRECTION and FXI (1W: -1.99% | 1M: +3.25%) CORRECTION.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Mixed: IBIT (1W: +3.09% | 1M: +12.14%) ABOVE TREND signals crypto risk-on, while ARKK (1W: -1.09% | 1M: +10.87%) CORRECTION and Speculation Index (1W: -3.22% | 1M: +1.47%) CORRECTION show some profit-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Reflation bias: USO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND showing strength; GLD (1W: -2.05% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION reflects profit-taking in gold.

8. Energy Trend?  
Mixed energy picture: XLE (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -6.34%) RECOVERY, BNO (1W: +7.38% | 1M: +6.04%) ABOVE TREND, and UNG (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -10.32%) BELOW TREND — crude strength but natural gas weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: XLK (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +14.46%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: +0.97% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND. Divergences: multiple ETFs in CORRECTION (XBI, ARKK, SLV, VGK) — minor-to-moderate divergence; watch momentum.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to tech/semis (XLK, SOXX) and reflation commodities (USO, CPER) while monitoring credit stress (HYG/LQD) and VXX; reduce exposure to defensive rotation trades until breadth confirms.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +14.46%) ABOVE TREND — if SPY/TLT holds ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLF (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +6.87%) CORRECTION — if credit spread widens further.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: USO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND on reflation flows. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -10.32%) BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -2.05% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION if risk sentiment flips.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~29.5 (VXX 1W: +0.68% | 1M: -15.74%) RECOVERY — watch for further rises. Credit spread HYG/LQD ~0.7338 (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.54%) ABOVE TREND — breach higher is risk. Tech vs Financials ratio ~3.0085 (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND — keep as leadership pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and semis showing strength — XLK (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +14.46%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +8.63% | 1M: +29.32%) ABOVE TREND — while commodities/energy (USO, CPER) are also showing strength.  
Key risk is rising credit stress and renewed volatility — monitor credit spread (HYG/LQD 0.7338; 1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.54%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: +1.79% | 1M: -13.87%) RECOVERY.
